metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for systematic development workflows

plugins.name: rdi
plugins.description: A systematic workflow plugin that guides Claude through research, design, and implementation phases for code changes. Ensures thorough understanding, careful planning, and verified implementation of complex features.

plugins.name: ruff-lsp
plugins.description: Ruff language server for Python — fast linting and formatting diagnostics via the ruff LSP, with a bundled ruff.toml configuration.

plugins.name: ty-lsp
plugins.description: ty language server for Python — fast type checking and type-aware navigation (go to definition, hover, references) via the ty LSP.

plugins.name: uv
plugins.description: Modern Python package and project management with uv — initialization, dependencies, virtual environments, Python versions, lockfiles, monorepos, CI/CD, and migration from legacy tools.

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: Design and evolve APIs with Stripe-style date-based versioning and strict backwards-compatibility rules — additive by default, breaking changes pinned to a new dated version with backward transforms.

plugins.name: chezmoi
plugins.description: Manage dotfiles across machines with chezmoi — daily workflow, templating, prompt-on-init, age/gpg encryption, password managers, and multi-repo public/private architectures where private content is always pushed encrypted with the key kept elsewhere.
